input.args: Apply only this exactly approved selection patch for existing entry {{ steps.prepare-feature-selection.output.selected_entry_id }}: {{ steps.prepare-feature-selection.output.proposed_patch }}. Preserve any existing specification and do not author one or change another entry.

approve.prompt: After the approved roadmap write succeeds, verify the selected entry {{ steps.prepare-feature-selection.output.selected_entry_id }} uniquely maps to {{ steps.prepare-feature-selection.output.feature_directory }}. Only then call the installed controller helper activate-feature with project root and JSON on stdin containing feature_directory equal to that exact approved target. Capture its result; it updates only .specify/feature.json, preserving other fields. Do not create the feature directory, spec.md, checklist, branch, or other artifact. If the write or pointer activation fails, stop and report the partial state and exact recovery action; do not silently undo the approved roadmap change or create another feature.

Re-read the selected roadmap row and .specify/feature.json. Verify the unique exact entry-to-directory mapping and active pointer agree with the approved selection, and no specification was created or modified. Return selected_entry_id, feature_directory, existing_spec state, evidence, and any blocker. A target directory without spec.md is a valid selection awaiting authoring, not a missing prerequisite to repair by creating a spec. Stop for divergence; do not claim activation from command success alone.
